name: index_borel_le
summary: index·|B| = |GL_k(K)| = Π q^i(q^{i+1} − 1), and |B| ≥ (q − 1)^k·q^{k(k−1)/2} through an injective map from tuples (diagonal unit, entries left of the diagonal) to B; dividing gives the flag count.

steps.claim: Let B be the lower triangular subgroup.

index(B)·|B| = |GL_k(K)| = Π_{i<k} q^i(q^{i+1} − 1) (card_GL_eq_prod), and |B| is at least the number of tuples (x_i)_{i<k} of a unit (the diagonal entry) and a row of entries left of the diagonal, Π_i (q − 1)q^i, since such a tuple determines a lower triangular invertible matrix and distinct tuples give distinct matrices; dividing, the index is at most Π_i (q^{i+1} − 1)/(q − 1).
steps.lean:
simpa [card_GL_eq_prod, Nat.card_pi, Nat.card_units, prod_range, Finite.one_lt_card,
    prod_pow_eq_pow_sum,
    field] using mono_cast (α := ℝ) (A.index_mul_card.le.trans' (mul_le_mul_left _
    (card_le_card_of_injective (fun x : ∀ i, Kˣ × (Set.Iio i → K) ↦ ⟨.mkOfDetNeZero (of fun i j ↦
    ite _ 0 (dite _ ((x i).2 ⟨j, ·⟩) fun _ ↦ (x i).1)) (by simp +contextual [BlockTriangular,
    det_of_isLowerTriangular, univ.prod_eq_zero_iff]), fun _ _ ↦ (ite_eq_left ·)⟩) fun x y h ↦ by
    ext i j <;> [simpa using congr($h.1 i i); simpa [lt_asymm, j.2.out] using congr($h.1 i j)])))
